name: When do I need a room addition instead of remodeling existing space?

mainEntity.name: When do I need a room addition instead of remodeling existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need a room addition when your current home lacks sufficient square footage to meet your needs, and reconfiguring existing space isn't enough. This is often the case when you require an entirely new room, like an extra bedroom, a dedicated home office, or a larger family room. If your existing layout works but is just too small, an addition is the appropriate solution to gain substantial new space, rather than simply updating or rearranging existing rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a room addition when you need entirely new square footage, such as an extra bedroom or a larger living space, rather than just reconfiguring existing rooms.
